local.title: Sync is off
local.text: Your entries live only on this device — encrypted, in the browser’s storage. Turn on sync to use impact log on several devices and not lose your entries along with the browser.

points.e2ee: End-to-end encryption: the server sees only ciphertext
points.noEmail: Just a username and password — no email, no phone
points.keep: All entries from this device move into the account

local.signIn: Sign in to an existing account

signedOut.title: Sign in again
signedOut.text: Your server session has ended: it expired, you signed out everywhere, or this device was revoked. Entries on this device are safe — sync resumes after you sign in.

profile.title: Account
profile.accountIdHint: An opaque identifier: it reveals neither your username nor your region and stays the same if your data moves. Use it to refer to your account without sharing your username.

devices.title: Devices
devices.lead: Every browser you sign in from is a separate device. Device names are encrypted with your key: the server can’t see them.
devices.revokeText: The device loses access to the server: sync stops there and its remembered sign-in is reset. Entries already downloaded to it stay there — they can only be wiped on that device itself.

password.title: Password
password.text: Your password encrypts the key to your data and never goes to the server. After a change, other devices will ask you to sign in again.
password.done: Password changed. Other sessions were ended.

recoveryKey.title: Recovery Key
recoveryKey.text: The emergency key to your data. It works together with a second factor, and without one — only after 48 hours. A new key replaces the old one immediately.
recoveryKey.done: The new Recovery Key is active, the old one no longer works.

password.how: “Recover with Recovery Key” on the sign-in page: the key and a 2FA code.

phone.how: Sign in with your password and choose “No access to my 2FA app” at the code step: the key replaces the code.

all.how: The key alone — access opens after 48 hours, and your signed-in devices see a warning and can cancel it.

totp.title: Two-factor protection
totp.text: Codes from an authenticator app. Reissue it if you changed phones. Lost it? At sign-in, choose “No access to my 2FA app” and sign in with your password and Recovery Key.
totp.lostPhone: No access to your authenticator app? Sign out and sign in again: at the code step, choose “No access to my 2FA app” — your password and Recovery Key set up new 2FA.

recoveryPending.title: Account recovery with your Recovery Key has started
recoveryPending.text: Without your password and 2FA, it becomes available {date} ({relative}). If this isn’t you, cancel it and issue a new Recovery Key.
recoveryPending.textReady: It’s already available without your password and 2FA (since {date}). If this isn’t you, cancel it right now and issue a new Recovery Key.
recoveryPending.itsMe: If this is you, there’s nothing to do.
recoveryPending.confirmText: Whoever started it won’t be able to continue without the password or a 2FA code. The Recovery Key itself keeps working — issue a new one after cancelling.
recoveryPending.doneText: The Recovery Key still works. If you didn’t start the recovery, someone else has the key — issue a new one and the old one stops working immediately.

session.title: Sign out
session.text: Signing out disconnects this device from the account. Choose what to do with the entries in this browser.
session.keepHint: The device becomes local: entries stay here, sync stops.
session.wipeHint: Entries are removed from this browser. They stay on the server and your other devices.
session.wipeOption: Also wipe entries from this device
session.pending: Not yet sent to the server: {count}. Wiping will lose these changes.
session.everywhereHint: Ends all sessions and resets remembered computers. You’ll need to sign in again everywhere, including here.
session.everywhereText: All sessions will be ended and remembered computers reset. Entries stay on your devices, sync resumes after you sign in.
session.everywhereDone: All sessions ended. Sign in again to continue syncing.

delete.title: Delete account
delete.text: The account and all encrypted data on the server are deleted immediately and permanently — no trash bin. Entries on this device stay unless you wipe them separately.
delete.dialogText: Confirm with your password and a code from the app. This can’t be undone.
delete.doneText: Server data is gone. Your entries remain on this device as a local vault — keep them or wipe them.
